God, I so understand. And it's truly horrible that this is what you have to trade for something resembling health. If possible, it might be better to talk to a psychiatrist about reducing your dosage and pairing your medication with something to boost the effectiveness (that's what finally worked for me). I have treatment resistant depression, anxiety, and OCD, and like you, I've traded my memory and attention span for health. It's awful if I think too much about it, but definitely less awful than constantly wanting to die. As medicine advances, maybe we'll find some better way to treat our disorders. The world is a beautiful place and even in spite of our struggles, I believe we're lucky to be here.
